critique_history.assessment:
- The aperture and lip visibly float beside the shell; conform them tightly to the lower body surface.
- The silhouette resembles stacked tiered cones rather than smoothly connected rounded whorls; soften the ledges and transitions.
- Cream bands are overly broad and regular; use narrower, noisily undulating spiral markings with subtler raised growth texture.
The elongated pointed form, rounded spiral whorls, attached aperture, and wavy brown-and-cream growth bands convincingly represent an auger shell.
